taskTree.description: The hierarchical structure of tasks in the DAG.

taskGroups.description: Information about all task groups within the DAG, keyed by group id.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations of the loop (Airflow 3.4+). Present for a loop group only.

has_until.description: Whether the loop has an until condition that can stop it before max_iterations (Airflow 3.4+). Present for a loop group only.

gate_task_id.description: Id of the loop's gate, the task that ends each iteration and decides whether the loop goes on (Airflow 3.4+). Present for a loop group only.

terminal_task_id.description: Id of the last task of the loop body, whose result the gate and the next iteration read (Airflow 3.4+). Present for a loop group only.

tasks.description: Details of all individual tasks within the DAG, keyed by task id.

task_group.description: Full id of the task's own task group, a key of taskGroups.

loop_group.description: Full id of the loop the task runs in (Airflow 3.4+), a key of taskGroups. It is task_group when the task sits directly in the loop, and an enclosing group of it when the task is in a task group inside the loop. Null outside a loop.
